retention.stated: until the instance is recycled; not persistent

egress.terms: Not metered on the free plan (bandwidth is bundled), but 30 MB of storage makes egress moot.

tooling: redis-cli, any Redis client (redis-py, ioredis), RESP over TLS; RedisInsight GUI
chaining: 30 MB x 1 DB. Creating multiple free databases is the only path, and Redis Cloud's free plan is one 30 MB DB per subscription — you would need ~17,000 free subscriptions for 500 GB. This is the weakest structured store on bytes.
limits_note: 30 MB memory; single DB; no persistence guarantees on the free tier beyond snapshotting; eviction policy applies under memory pressure
reliability_note: Redis Cloud free is a real managed instance and stable, but with 30 MB it is a cache, not storage. Data can be evicted under maxmemory pressure.

evidence.proved: 'Free | Up to 30 MB | 30 MB single DB | From $0/hour'; Essentials from $0.007/hour; Pro from $0.014/hour
